title: Basic HTML test
summary: A plain title and paragraph to test the submission workflow.
author: Dzintars IT
requirements: A title and one sentence in English
A browser to open the generated HTML
steps: Give the assistant SKILL.md, the title Hello world, and the sentence This is my first test skill.
Save the returned HTML as example.html.
Open example.html in a browser; it should contain one heading and one paragraph.
distinctive: An owner-requested workflow test using browser defaults. It is intentionally basic and does not claim a unique visual style.
limitations: This tests submission mechanics, not creative quality. It has no styling or interactivity. AI assistants may produce different markup.
proof_note: Codex authored the skill and example from the stated input. The preview is a Chromium screenshot of the committed example, checked for one h1 and one paragraph. No external model comparison or originality assessment was performed.
